## Problem

What user problem is difficult today? Describe the workflow, not only the desired implementation.

## Proposed outcome

What should the user be able to do?

## Why pittiquita?

Why does this belong in pittiquita rather than the host app, HTML to Design, Figma, Storybook, or a design system?

## Constraints and alternatives

Include alternatives considered and any API, compatibility, security/privacy, bundle, or demo impact.

## Acceptance evidence

How could a reviewer verify that the outcome works without private accounts or production data?
